about.title: AI Teachable Machine
about.description: A closed-source, browser-based tool for building simple machine learning classifiers with your own data. All training runs locally in your browser — images and audio never leave your device unless you choose to share them. This project is private and not publicly distributed.
privacy: This is a closed-source project. All information, materials, and access are private and not public.
When you train a classifier, your samples stay on your device. Processing happens locally in your browser.
This tool can be deployed offline on computers with no internet connection, so classroom work can stay fully private.
If you use sharing features while online, data may be sent directly between devices using a temporary connection code.
This demo does not use cookies for tracking or analytics.
For questions about this demo, please contact the organization that provided you access.
